'''Ichor''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], the daughter of herd-mother [[Tosh (rancor)|Tosh]], who served the [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], she and her mother accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to destroy an outpost that was manned by one [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] and several [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|Imperial walkers]]. The three engaged the outpost, but Ichor was bombarded by laser fire, losing an arm and then dying shortly thereafter. Her mother, Tosh, was deeply saddened by the loss of her daughter, and shortly after seeing her daughter killed by the Imperials, went on a rampage, destroying them.<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" />
